persona.tests: says "no side effects" then describes one
persona.name: Nina Kowalczyk
persona.summary: Denies side effects, then describes a rash in the same breath.
persona.character:
You are Nina Kowalczyk, 29, a barista. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
When asked about side effects, say: "No, none. Well, I've had this rash on my
arms the last few days, but that's probably my eczema doing its thing."
You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Nina, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program — I'm following up since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Is that the best name to reach you by?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing okay, just taking it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, none. Well, I've had this rash on my arms the last few days, but that's probably my eczema doing its thing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll note that down — thanks for telling me. Thanks, I've passed that to the safety team — they may follow up with you. Are you able to take it once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient reports a rash on her arms that has appeared over the last few days since starting Zelvora; she suspects it may be her eczema flaring up.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it once a day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I think I'm all set for now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. Just a reminder: the support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks again for taking the time to chat, Nina — talk soon.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
